daily.title: Consequential Assessment Invalid Once Original Reassessment Is Quashed: ITAT Hyderabad
daily.summary: Hyderabad ITAT held that a consequential assessment and CIT(A) remand directions cannot survive once the original reassessment is quashed for lack of jurisdicti Can a fresh assessment made under a CIT(A) remand order survive when the Tribunal subsequently quashes the original reassessment for lack of jurisdiction? The Hyderabad ITAT answered this question in Sri Light Chit Fund P. Ltd. v. ITO, ITA No. 2581/HYD/2026 , decided on 20 November 2026 for AY 2018–19 . The Bench held that the remand direction and the assessment made to give effect to it fell with the original reassessment.

daily.title: ITAT Raipur: CIT(A) Must Verify Additional Evidence on Merits Before Granting Relief
daily.summary: ITAT Raipur sets aside relief based on unverified additional evidence and directs a fresh remand report and speaking order under Section 250. The report contained no findings on the documents themselves . The CIT(A) recognised that the report had failed to serve its purpose. The appellate order also recorded that the Assessing Officer had earlier challenged the grant of relief without a remand report. Even so, the CIT(A) proceeded to grant relief by order dated 7 August 2026 , without recording any specific inquiry or verification of the additional material. The Revenue appealed to the Tribunal.

daily.summary: The Rajasthan High Court has recently ruled that interest awarded on motor accident compensation under Section 171 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, from the filing of a claim petition until the award,... daily.title: ITAT Hyderabad: Pre-Amendment Section 14A Disallowance Cannot Exceed Exempt Income
daily.summary: ITAT Hyderabad caps Section 14A disallowance at Rs.56.79 lakh and holds that the Finance Act 2022 amendment cannot apply retrospectively to AY 2018-19. Can the Assessing Officer disallow ₹5.35 crore under Section 14A when the company earned only ₹56.79 lakh in exempt income ? In DCIT Vs My Home Constructions Private Limited, ITA No. 2352/HYD/2025 , decided on 20 November 2026 , the Hyderabad ITAT held that, under the law applicable to AY 2018–19 , the disallowance could not exceed the exempt income earned during the year.

daily.title: ICAI Releases Technical Guide on GST Annual Return (GSTR-9) for FY 2025-26
daily.summary: ICAI releases a technical guide on GSTR-9 for FY 2025-26, offering guidance on GST annual return filing and compliance requirements. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) released the fourth edition of its Technical Guide on GST Annual Return (Form GSTR-9) for FY 2025-26, incorporating legislative amendments and procedural clarifications up to October 2026. The November 2026 edition gives table-wise guidance on annual return filing, mandatory and optional disclosures, Input Tax Credit (ITC) reporting, tax payments and reconciliation requirements. Regular taxpayers with an aggregate annual turnover exceeding Rs. 2 crore are required to file Form GSTR-9.
